propositions: The complexity-baseline lock policy currently executes four times per Verified change: once in each OS/Python test-matrix cell (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.12), consuming ~206 runner-seconds total when a single ~5s invocation would suffice.
The lock is a commit-level policy with no OS or Python version dependencies; it should run once in the single lint job and be absent from the test matrix.

Moving the unchanged script invocation and definition-vs-tree guard from jobs.test to jobs.lint preserves fail-closed behavior and blocking semantics while eliminating ~201 net runner-seconds per Verified run.
A workflow unit oracle must enforce exactly one complexity-lock invocation across the build-and-test workflow and fail on any future duplicate placement in the matrix.
